annotations.text:
A · DOSSIER — editorial / investigative.
Sherlock as a case file: serif masthead, warm paper, verdict as a stamp, findings as numbered 'exhibits'. Most distinctive and ownable; least like a generic SOC dashboard.

B · TERMINAL — command deck.
Refined hacker aesthetic: monospace, near-black, one electric accent, live command prompt + streaming trace. High-density, precise, feels fast and technical.

C · ELEVATED — modern SaaS (light).
The Linear/Vanta lane, properly polished: sidebar, soft shadows, generous whitespace, Space Grotesk + one confident accent. Safest, most familiar to buyers.
